source: runtime capture (SkyZH) 2026-09-10 花园实测; https://hypixelskyblock.minecraft.wiki/w/Fear_Mongerer (2026-09-03 更新); 交叉核对 https://hypixel-skyblock.fandom.com/wiki/Fear_Mongerer (一致)
note: Fear Mongerer(名字保留英文,项目既定),惊魂节期间在村庄收糖果的神秘商人。作为花园访客时故意说得像神谕,阴森庄重;中文不用伪文言,靠短句和克制的用词制造压迫感。惊魂节商店和 Abiphone 台词在 Events/NPC_Message/Fear_Mongerer.json。

messages.raw: §fMortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
messages.text: Mortal, the time of reckoning is near. The Past will light the future.
messages.zh: 凡人,清算之时将至。过往将照亮未来。

messages.raw: §fMay your destiny be ridded with fortune.
messages.text: May your destiny be ridded with fortune.
messages.gloss: ridded with 本义是「摆脱」,原文故意用错词制造反讽——像祝福又像诅咒;中文用「缠身」保留这股别扭劲。
messages.zh: 愿你的命运被好运缠身。
